summary: In the days after October 7, Lombardo affirmed Nevada's support for Israel at a Las Vegas temple, at a community event with other state leaders, and in a delegation united behind Israel. In June 2025 he signed SB 179, adopting IHRA's working definition of antisemitism into Nevada law, a measure People's Tribune reports Palestinian-solidarity advocates opposed on free-speech grounds. These actions mark Lombardo as a public defender of Israel who has also codified a framework critics say restricts anti-Israel speech.
